nodes.label: Unit tests for freeze frame extraction.  Covers FreezeFrameRecord Pydantic model
Return a minimal valid Mode $02 snapshot with all 12 mandatory PIDs.
Pydantic model validation — mandatory fields, constraints, extra fields.
All 12 mandatory PIDs present → model construct successfully.
Extended PIDs (§10.5) are optional and default to None.
Derived flags (§11) default to False before extraction.
Each of the 6 derived flags fires when its wiki §11 trigger is met.
Each flag stays False when just below or at the threshold boundary.
CLV low AND RPM high → flag False.
Ignition advance = −10° (at threshold, not < −10) → flag False.
Scenarios where more than one flag fires simultaneously.
Cold engine + open loop: ff_ect_warmup AND ff_open_loop_at_fault.
Hot engine + severe timing retard: both flags fire.
